title: Most Compelling Evidence That the K-Field Is a Fundamental Structure Beneath Known Physics
thesis: The strongest evidence is the convergence of independent astronomical, geometric, physical-constant, reciprocal-metric, recursive-structure, and laboratory analyses on one tightly constrained oriented geometry.

evidence.name: Independent recovery of oriented Cell3 geometry
evidence.significance: Structurally different methods recover the same highly constrained three-dimensional geometry from astronomical data without beginning from particle or atomic constants.

evidence.name: Mass Bridge closure
evidence.description: Cell3 face-area ratios organize mass and electromagnetic scales through a shared geometric carrier.
evidence.significance: Multiple linked physical ratios arise from one internally consistent geometric object rather than from independent numerical fittings.

evidence.name: Reciprocal-metric interaction hierarchy

interpretation.reciprocal_geometry: Specifies coupling, exchange, propagation, and resistance channels

evidence.significance: The same cell contains both structural information and an ordered interaction hierarchy, supporting a substrate-level interpretation.

evidence.name: Cross-domain directional recurrence
evidence.significance: Astronomical and terrestrial systems obtained through independent measurement pipelines organize under the same directional geometry.

evidence.name: Lucas-limit and seven-sheet organization
evidence.description: Shared-face repetition of Cell3 produces a minimal higher-order volume containing seven alternating-polarity sheets.
evidence.significance: The framework supplies an internal dynamical organization connecting static geometry to modulation and measurable response.

central_inference: One oriented geometry compresses astronomical organization, dimensionless physical ratios, interaction hierarchies, recursive sheet structure, and laboratory anisotropy into a common dependency system.
evaluation_principle: The evidentiary strength lies in independent reconstruction, internal dependency, cross-domain recurrence, and explanatory compression rather than in any single numerical agreement.
